signal.rationale: A firm INR 20 crore order from SAMM Corporation is stated in the 7 Aug 2026 press release, equal to 38.9% of FY26 revenue of INR 51.40 crore. The packet shows no earlier comparable order disclosures, so the order is not routine. It is an external export order from a company with positive PAT (INR 7.05 crore FY26) and no disqualifier; the illiquidity flag is not a disqualifier under the rules. The INR 8 crore order ambition is forecast-only and was excluded from sizing.

events.quote: The order is scheduled to be executed from August 2026 onwards and is expected to contribute approximately ₹8 Crore in FY27 and ₹12 Crore in FY28.

KVS Castings Limited Secures ₹20 Crore Railway Components Order for Russian Railways Kashipur, August 07, 2026: KVS Castings Limited, the Foundry Division of the KVS Premier Group and a trusted manufacturer of high-quality ferrous castings, including Cast Iron and Ductile Iron, has secured a ₹20 Crore order from SAMM Corporation, Delhi (Merchant Exporter) for the manufacture and supply of railway parts to be used in the Russian Railways.
